title: Parity under binary sign conversion
statement: For every $n$ and every set $S$ of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the parity sign on binary inputs, transported to the sign cube by the coordinatewise binary-to-sign correspondence, equals the product of the input signs over $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
